response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and polyglot development skills with a focus on testability and open-source contributions, but his experience lacks depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His leadership and mentoring experience is present but not explicitly tied to cloud or DevOps contexts, and his technical strategy work has been more product-focused than infrastructure-focused.
strengths: Proven leadership and mentoring experience, including organizing workshops and technical talks.
Diverse technical background with contributions to open-source projects and developer tooling.
Strong problem-solving skills and experience with distributed systems and real-time data processing.
concerns: Lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience, with only limited exposure (e.g., National Instruments role).
No explicit experience with cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure leadership in a cloud context.
Technical leadership has been more product- and team-focused rather than infrastructure- or platform-focused.
